Sylvanas Windrunner – Ashe Custom Skin

This custom skin brings Sylvanas Windrunner from World of Warcraft into League of Legends, transforming Ashe into the iconic Banshee Queen.

Take control of Sylvanas on the Rift and experience Ashe through a full visual rework based on the World of Warcraft character.

This skin delivers a dark fantasy version of Ashe with a complete Sylvanas-themed identity and atmosphere.

Features
Reworked 3D model
Custom loading screen
Modified ability icons
Fully reworked VFX

The skin will continue to evolve through future updates, so stay tuned.
